Application Data.NAME: Melody Instruments, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Melody Instruments, Inc. specializes in the retail sale and repair of musical instruments, offering a wide range of products including guitars, pianos, and brass instruments. Our operations include in-store sales, personalized repair services, and limited on-site tuning for clients. We prioritize high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction while maintaining a secure retail environment with basic security measures. Our services involve trained technicians handling delicate instruments, ensuring that all repair processes adhere to stringent quality controls to minimize risk.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a customer reported damage to a violin during a repair process due to an accidental drop. The estimated cost of repair was $2,000. The claim is currently in progress, awaiting parts. On 08/10/2023, there was a theft incident when a guitar valued at $1,500 was stolen from the store. The police report has been filed, and we anticipate recovering the loss through an insurance claim. Total incurred losses amount to $3,500, with both incidents being managed adequately and no prior similar claims in the last three years.
